questions.prompt: A ___ helps sick people in hospital.
questions.explanation_ar: اللي بيساعد المرضى في المستشفى هو الدكتور: doctor. carpenter نجار وengineer مهندس.
questions.explanation_en: The one who helps sick people in the hospital is the doctor: doctor. carpenter is نجار and engineer is مهندس.

questions.prompt: A ___ helps the doctor and takes care of patients.
questions.explanation_ar: اللي بيساعد الدكتور وبيهتم بالمرضى هو الممرضة: nurse. teacher معلم وfirefighter رجل إطفاء.
questions.explanation_en: The one who helps the doctor and cares for patients is the nurse: nurse. teacher is معلم and firefighter is رجل إطفاء.

questions.prompt: A ___ stops fires and saves people.
questions.explanation_ar: اللي بيطفي الحرايق وبينقذ الناس هو رجل الإطفاء: firefighter. police officer شرطي.
questions.explanation_en: The one who puts out fires and saves people is the firefighter: firefighter. police officer is شرطي.

questions.prompt: A ___ catches thieves and keeps us safe.
questions.explanation_ar: اللي بيمسك الحرامية وبيحمينا هو الشرطي: police officer. nurse وteacher مش وظيفتهم كده.
questions.explanation_en: The one who catches thieves and protects us is the police officer: police officer. A nurse and a teacher do not do that job.

questions.prompt: An ___ designs bridges and buildings.
questions.explanation_ar: المهندس (engineer) هو اللي بيصمم الكباري والمباني. بنستخدم an قبلها لأنها بتبدأ بصوت متحرك (e).
questions.explanation_en: The engineer (engineer) is the one who designs bridges and buildings. We use an before it because it starts with a vowel sound (e).

questions.prompt: A ___ makes things from wood.
questions.explanation_ar: اللي بيعمل حاجات من الخشب هو النجار: carpenter. teacher وdoctor شغلهم مختلف.
questions.explanation_en: The one who makes things from wood is the carpenter: carpenter. A teacher and a doctor have different jobs.

questions.prompt: A ___ takes beautiful photos of people and places.
questions.explanation_ar: اللي بيصور صور حلوة للناس والأماكن هو المصور: photographer.
questions.explanation_en: The one who takes nice pictures of people and places is the photographer: photographer.

questions.prompt: A ___ actor uses his voice for cartoons.
questions.explanation_ar: الممثل اللي بيستخدم صوته في الكارتون اسمه voiceover actor. carpenter وpolice مش بيناسبوا الجملة.
questions.explanation_en: The actor who uses his voice in cartoons is called a voiceover actor. carpenter and police do not fit the sentence.

questions.prompt: The puppet maker makes funny ___ for children.
questions.explanation_ar: صانع العرايس بيعمل عرايس مضحكة للأطفال: puppets. nails مسامير وuniforms زي رسمي.
questions.explanation_en: The puppet maker makes funny puppets for children: puppets. nails is مسامير and uniforms is زي رسمي.

questions.prompt: The firefighter wears a special ___ at work.

questions.explanation_en: The firefighter wears a special uniform at work: uniform. medal is ميدالية and dress is فستان.

questions.prompt: A ___ helps young workers learn their job. (الموجّه)
questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (الموجّه) معناها mentor، وهو اللي بيساعد العمال الجدد يتعلموا شغلهم.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (الموجّه) means mentor, and he is the one who helps new workers learn their job.

questions.prompt: A wildlife photographer takes photos of ___.

questions.explanation_en: A wildlife photographer (wildlife photographer) takes pictures of wild animals: wild animals.

questions.prompt: Workers ___ new houses with bricks and wood.

questions.explanation_en: The workers build new houses with bricks and wood: build. repair means يصلّح and design means يصمم.

questions.prompt: The carpenter uses a ___ and nails.
questions.explanation_ar: النجار بيستخدم مطرقة (hammer) ومسامير. camera كاميرا وfire نار.
questions.explanation_en: The carpenter uses a hammer (hammer) and nails. camera is كاميرا and fire is نار.

questions.prompt: He hit the ___ with the hammer. (المسمار)

questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (المسمار) means nail, and we hit it with the hammer.

questions.prompt: We fix a broken chair; we ___ it.

questions.prompt: He drove ___ and broke the car. (بلا انتباه)

questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (بلا انتباه) means carelessly, because he broke the car. carefully is بانتباه.

questions.prompt: I ___ my bad words. I am sorry. (أندم على)

questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (أندم على) means regret: I regret my bad words means "I am sorry."

questions.prompt: The carpenter put the wood ___ on the table. (اللوح)
